title: John Ramirez says everyone is waiting for Elizondo to talk about hybrids

tellings.quote: And then you've got John Ramirez, who in 2022 uh made comments to the effect that everyone is waiting for Lue Elizondo to talk about hybrids.

plain: A witness named Jason Samosa, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that in 2022 a man named John Ramirez remarked that everyone was waiting for Lue Elizondo to talk about hybrids, meaning beings that are part human and part non-human. If true, it would suggest Elizondo knows something about such hybrids that he has not yet said.
